## 🔍 Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of RepoPulse.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.

- [ ] The app builds cleanly without any TypeScript or bundling errors (`npm run build`).
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors.
- [ ] I have verified responsive layouts on both desktop and mobile viewports.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or credentials are included in this PR.
